title: Inside the Piano Lid  (钢琴盖里)

segments.t: 汉娜把伊夫林小姐叫到刚亮起灯的日光室，凯勒布指着卡在钢琴木质谱架后面的一张米白色纸张一角。请先完整听一遍这段场景。
You fixed the ceiling lamp! The walnut wood shines like honey now!
Look right here behind the folding music desk when the lamp shines down.
Is that folded music paper stuck inside the hinge?
Let me slide it out gently with two fingers so the paper does not tear.
Handwritten notes in black ink! Can you read the title on top, Evelyn?
'Courtyard Waltz — for Friday Evening Tea, May, thirty years ago.'
That matches the exact date on the postcard in the cedar box!
Let me hum the opening bar... oh, what a gentle, singing melody!
Wait, turn the sheet over! Half of page two is blank!
The composer wrote twenty-four bars and stopped right in the middle of a phrase!
And look at the penciled note at the bottom: 'Finish before Friday.'
Why did the music stop thirty years ago, and who wrote it?!
现在我们来逐句学习这段发现之旅。
You fixed the ceiling lamp! The walnut wood shines like honey now!
‘你们修好了吸顶灯！胡桃木现在像蜂蜜一样亮泽！’古董钢琴中备受青睐的优质胡桃木用英文说是
walnut wood
，而 shines like honey 描绘了新灯照射下的金色光泽。
Look right here behind the folding music desk when the lamp shines down.
‘趁着灯光往下照，快看这个折叠谱架后面。’钢琴上自带的用来放乐谱的架子叫做
folding music desk
，字面意思是“可折叠的小乐谱台”。
Is that folded music paper stuck inside the hinge?
‘那张折起来的五线谱纸是不是卡在合页里了？’当某物卡住或楔进缝隙里时，可以用
stuck inside the hinge?
，其中 hinge 指连接琴盖的金属合页（铰链）。
Let me slide it out gently with two fingers so the paper does not tear.
‘让我用两根手指小心地把它滑出来，免得把纸撕破。’把一张纸轻轻抽出来可以用
slide it out gently
，句末的 tear 指的是旧纸被撕破、扯裂。
Handwritten notes in black ink! Can you read the title on top, Evelyn?
‘是用黑墨水手写的音符！伊夫林，你能看清最上面的标题吗？’凡是用钢笔或铅笔亲手写下的内容，都可以用复合形容词
Handwritten notes
来形容，它由 hand 和过去分词 written 组合而成。
'Courtyard Waltz — for Friday Evening Tea, May, thirty years ago.'
‘《庭院华尔兹》——献给三十年前五月的周五下午茶。’这种三拍子的舞蹈写作
Waltz
，而 thirty years ago 则是从现在往回推算日期。
That matches the exact date on the postcard in the cedar box!
‘这跟雪松木盒里那张明信片上的日期完全吻合！’当两条线索或信息彼此匹配且中间不需要介词时，最合适的动词是
matches the exact date
，宾语可以直接跟在 match 后面。
Let me hum the opening bar... oh, what a gentle, singing melody!
‘让我哼唱一下开头这一小节……哦，多么轻柔悦耳的旋律啊！’在音乐中，由小节线隔开的每一小节叫做 bar，因此
the opening bar...
就引出了整份乐谱的开头。
Wait, turn the sheet over! Half of page two is blank!
‘等等，把纸翻过来！第二页有一半是空白的！’要把一页纸或卡片翻过来看背面，可以把 turn 和 over 搭配使用：
turn the sheet over!
，而 blank 表示纸上什么字也没有写。
The composer wrote twenty-four bars and stopped right in the middle of a phrase!
‘作曲的人写了二十四个小节，就在乐句中间戛然而止了！’为了强调音乐在半途中突然中断，这里用到了
right in the middle of
，其中的 phrase 也可以指音乐中的“乐句”。
And look at the penciled note at the bottom: 'Finish before Friday.'
‘再看底部用铅笔写的附注：周五前完成。’由名词 pencil 派生出了分词形容词
penciled note
用于之后可以擦掉的速记。
Why did the music stop thirty years ago, and who wrote it?!
“为什么音乐在三十年前停了下来，又是谁写下它的！？”注意这两个并列问句之间的对比：第一句带有助动词 did，而第二句
who wrote it?!
不带助动词，因为 who 本身就是 wrote 的主语。让我们再连贯听一遍整场戏。
You fixed the ceiling lamp! The walnut wood shines like honey now!
Look right here behind the folding music desk when the lamp shines down.
Is that folded music paper stuck inside the hinge?
Let me slide it out gently with two fingers so the paper does not tear.
Handwritten notes in black ink! Can you read the title on top, Evelyn?
'Courtyard Waltz — for Friday Evening Tea, May, thirty years ago.'
That matches the exact date on the postcard in the cedar box!
Let me hum the opening bar... oh, what a gentle, singing melody!
Wait, turn the sheet over! Half of page two is blank!
The composer wrote twenty-four bars and stopped right in the middle of a phrase!
And look at the penciled note at the bottom: 'Finish before Friday.'
Why did the music stop thirty years ago, and who wrote it?!
在钢琴内部深处，沉睡着一首三十年前的手写未完成曲谱《庭院圆舞曲》。我们还有最后一场戏来为这第二集画上句号。
Goodbye!
